title: Implement deployment evidence, lineage, and log views
objective: Replace the deployment route placeholder with a deployment detail workspace that exposes source/build/artifact/deployment/route lineage, artifact proof, evidence checks, route revision state, and build logs.
actions: Replace deploymentRoutes.tsx placeholder exports with the /deployments/:deploymentId route element.
Implement DeploymentDetailPage with a header, status, copy/export evidence actions, and last-updated/stale-state copy.
Implement LineageChain for source event, build job, artifact, deployment, and route revision with horizontal scroll below tablet widths and equal columns on desktop.
Implement EvidenceTable for framework preset, output directory, manifest/checksum, route validation, CDN operation, and rollback protection checks.
Implement BuildTimeline and ArtifactProof panels that distinguish build success, artifact verification, route apply, CDN skipped/failed, and previous known-good preservation.
Implement LogPanel with dark monospace styling, fixed-height scroll region, cursor/range log metadata, and redaction before rendering.
Use API polling boundary state to show active build/log/route updates separately from static deployment success.
Render explicit states for queued, running, failed build, verified-not-routed, route-pending, route-applied, route-failed, route-drift, CDN-disabled, and CDN-failed fixtures.

files.purpose: lineage, evidence, timeline, logs, artifact, and route panels
feature-scoped forensic grid, lineage, evidence, and log styles
route and component tests for deployment evidence views

new_tests: DeploymentDetailPage renders the full source_event -> build_job -> artifact -> deployment -> route_revision lineage.
Verified artifact without applied route revision is not labeled as Routed.
LogPanel redacts secret-like canaries and still shows build step timestamps.
EvidenceTable distinguishes pass, failed, skipped, and stale route/CDN checks.

criteria: src/features/deployments/deploymentRoutes.tsx no longer imports RoutePlaceholder and exports a route element for /deployments/:deploymentId.
The deployment detail route contains visible labels Deployment lineage, Evidence table, Build log, Artifact proof, Route revision, and Source event.
Rendered deployment copy includes both deployment status and separate route revision/CDN status; a fixture with route_pending does not render the status text Routed.
src/features/deployments/components/LogPanel.tsx calls the shared redaction helper before rendering fixture log lines.
npm test -- --run src/features/deployments/deployments.test.tsx and npm run build pass.

risks: Deployment success and route/CDN success are separate states; merging them would hide partial failures.
Logs and manifests are high-risk leakage surfaces and must use the shared redaction helper.
Lineage and evidence tables need stable overflow rules to avoid layout overlap on mobile.

execution.findings: Implemented deployment detail workspace with fixture-backed route, separated deployment/route/CDN status copy, lineage, evidence, artifact proof, route panel, redacted logs, and local CDN operation normalization for redacted duplicate fixture refs.
execution.tests_passed: npm test -- --run src/features/deployments/deployments.test.tsx passed (5 tests); npm run build passed.
